title: Actual effort column and partial actual effort
goal: The steps table shows baseline, actual (final or so far, 0 when none recorded) and remaining effort side by side, with totals
acceptance: Columns Step, Baseline, Actual, Remaining, Status
actualDays allowed on started steps (not planned), shown as so far while open; 0 days when none is recorded
Total row and backlog total include recorded actual effort; no open steps reads as such
Calibration uses recorded actuals of closed steps only
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Released in v5.4.0 after PR #117 (CI 43070967196) and review-fix PR #118 (CI 43071564109) with independent review; baseline 0.5 focused day. No actual recorded: built within a longer session with other work, so a per-step figure would be invented.
